events.event: The rupiah closed at Rp18,245 per US dollar on 16 November (Refinitiv), weaker 0.30% from Rp18,190, after touching an intraday low of Rp18,270, with China's weak October data and higher external debt cited as drivers.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,245/US$ close (CNBC/Refinitiv), Rp18,268 (Kontan/Bloomberg), JISDOR Rp18,250 vs Rp18,218 · intraday low Rp18,270 · -0.30% d/d · DXY 103.407 · China Oct retail sales +0.4% y/y vs 0.8% expected · China industrial output +4.8% vs 5.5% prior
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah makes imports, fuel and electronics pricier, and it raises the pressure on BI one day before its rate decision.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC Indonesia, Kontan, Bisnis, Koridor and others on 16 Nov; vendors differ by tens of rupiah, so the source must be named

events.event: The IHSG closed down 0.44% at 5,320.98 on 16 November, snapping the previous week's 5.82% rally, as basic-materials and energy stocks (AMMN, BRMS, BRPT, DEWA) dragged the index.
events.key_numbers: 5,320.98 close, -23.43 pts (-0.44%) · turnover Rp10.35 T (CNBC) vs Rp12.91 T (Kontan) · basic materials -4.76% (Refinitiv) · energy -3.19% · 147 up / 227 down · DEWA -6.87%, BRPT -6.83%, WIFI -6.78% · foreign outflow about Rp505.6 B in session 1 (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether the MSCI/FTSE-driven rebound last week holds.
events.spreading_evidence: Widely reported by CNBC, Kontan, Okezone, RRI, Viva

events.event: FTSE Russell kept Indonesia as a Secondary Emerging Market and did not place it on a Watch List, but will remove stocks flagged for high shareholding concentration at its December review and freeze new additions and size changes until at least March 2027.
events.key_numbers: 14 Indonesian stocks removed per CNBC headline (count not in the statement article) · removal effective 21 Dec 2026 · provisional list to 4 Dec, final 7 Dec · IPO/new additions delayed until at least the March 2027 review
events.why_it_matters: It is a second global index provider acting on Indonesia's thin free float, after MSCI, and it affects foreign money flowing into stocks.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple CNBC items 14 Nov; IHSG reportedly fell about 1.17% on the news per smaller outlets (unverified)

events.event: Kemnaker's Industrial Relations director general Indah Anggoro Putri said under Law 27/2026 a government institution will centrally manage a severance reserve fund (dana cadangan pesangon) that employers must start depositing by October 2027, while Danantara denied being appointed to manage it.
events.key_numbers: UU No. 27/2026 · deposit deadline October 2027 · institution to operate 2028 · transition up to 1 year · micro and small businesses excluded · sanctions: warning, business restrictions, suspension, licence revocation · no contribution rate stated
events.why_it_matters: It decides who holds workers' severance money and how it is protected if the company folds.
events.spreading_evidence: Five detikFinance items on the front page within 24 hours, including a denial and a counter-denial

events.event: Bank Indonesia reported Q3 2026 external debt (ULN) at US$458.9 billion, up from US$455.4 billion, with government debt rising and private debt falling.
events.key_numbers: US$458.9 B Q3 2026 vs US$455.4 B (CNBC rupiah article, which does not say which period the comparison covers) · the preview article had August at US$459.3 B, so the comparison needs checking against the BI release
events.why_it_matters: Rising government debt while the rupiah sits near its weakest adds to worries about debt-servicing costs.

events.event: Danantara plans to publish its first public financial report, for fiscal 2025, tentatively on 23 November 2026, after BPK finished its audit, according to COO Dony Oskaria.
events.key_numbers: 23 Nov 2026 (tentative) · more than 1,000 consolidated companies (Rosan Roeslani) · over 1,070 SOE entities (Pahala Mansury) · first report since Danantara launched Feb 2025 · regulatory deadline was end of June
events.why_it_matters: The first look at the finances of the fund that now controls Indonesia's biggest state companies.

events.event: Deputy Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Dradjad Hari Wibowo said the government will pursue three measures to boost the capital market: raise listed-company valuations through deregulation, speed up rule enforcement, and expand investor education.
events.key_numbers: 3 measures · more than 34 million individual capital-market investors
events.why_it_matters: It is the government's response to the MSCI and FTSE pressure on the stock market.

events.event: Bank Indonesia is scheduled to publish the Q3 2026 Balance of Payments on 20 November, after a Q2 deficit.
events.key_numbers: Q2 2026 deficit US$0.9 B · release Fri 20 Nov 2026, time not stated
events.why_it_matters: It shows whether foreign money flowed in or out of Indonesia last quarter, which drives the rupiah.

events.event: Nvidia shares reportedly fell 13% after CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, per a detikFinance headline, and CNBC Indonesia separately reported his wealth dropped about Rp320 trillion after a scandal.
events.key_numbers: -13% Nvidia shares (headline only) · Rp320 T lost wealth (headline only) · Nvidia earnings due 17 Nov (E0839)
events.why_it_matters: Nvidia drives the global AI trade, so a leadership shock moves tech stocks worldwide.
events.spreading_evidence: Two outlets; the detik article could not be opened and the personal-scandal angle is unverified
